title: LedgerArtifact
description: Result of the ledger.artifact JSON-RPC method (nocx-m3fqk, design §6) — ONE artifact's body, joined from its chunks in seq order. It is a separate method from ledger.get on purpose: the recall read must not haul bytes (ADR-0019 §6), so the page and the detail carry metadata and whoever actually wants a body asks for it one at a time. This is what a restored block's output is drawn from. A read that names a row range returns ONE PAGE of a stored-rows artifact and the artifact's own coordinates (nocx-t7xhe): `firstRow`, `lastRow` and `rowCount` describe the whole block, and `rangeStart`, `rangeCount`, `hasMoreBefore` and `hasMoreAfter` describe the page. Those coordinates are null (and the counts zero) for a body that is not stored rows, because a row index has no meaning there.

id.description: The artifact asked for, echoed back.

mediaType.description: What the body is: application/vt carries the SGR a restored block draws, text/plain the derived text search and copy read, and application/x-nocx-rows is a streamed block's output — JSON Lines whose line shape ledger.blockRows.schema.json declares, one row of the screen frame's cell vocabulary per line.

body.description: The chunks joined in seq order. Empty is a real answer and means the command printed nothing — it is NOT the same as an artifact that is not there, which is a body retention has evicted and which this method reports by refusing the id (ADR-0019 §7).

truncated.description: Why the body is not the whole of what was printed, or null when it is: 'cap' when the middle was dropped at the per-command limit, 'gap' when a range was lost, 'suppressed' when capture was refused.

byteLen.description: The logical content bytes the store holds for this artifact — the retention budget's unit, and what a reader can check its join against.

firstRow.description: Absolute index of the artifact's first stored row, or null when the body is not stored rows or holds no row.

lastRow.description: Absolute index of the artifact's last stored row, or null as above.

rowCount.description: How many stored rows the artifact holds — the block's height, which a reader reserves before any page of it arrives. 0 for a body that is not stored rows.

rangeStart.description: Absolute index of this page's first row; null for a body that is not stored rows. A page past the end answers one past the artifact's last row, so 'nothing here' is distinguishable from row zero.

rangeCount.description: Rows in this page. 0 for a body that is not stored rows.

hasMoreBefore.description: Whether stored rows exist before this page. Always false for a body that is not stored rows.

hasMoreAfter.description: Whether stored rows exist after this page. Always false for a body that is not stored rows.
